dirs::data_local_dir(), matching the pattern already used by
the cache, session, and feedback modules.

On Linux: ~/.config/bivvy/ and ~/.local/share/bivvy/
On macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/bivvy/
EOF
)"

commit 5e6f5fb0fb86d9d3c4034f6721843047ff46df29
Author: benchmark <benchmark@localhost>
Date:   Tue Mar 17 00:18:09 2026 -0600

    Use platform-standard directories instead of ~/.bivvy
    
    Replace hardcoded ~/.bivvy paths with XDG-compliant directories
    via a centralized paths module. User config now resolves through
    dirs::config_dir() and application data through
    dirs::data_local_dir(), matching the pattern already used by
    the cache, session, and feedback modules.
    
    On Linux: ~/.config/bivvy/ and ~/.local/share/bivvy/
    On macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/bivvy/
